acceptance: Each contract type used by M1 is code in its component's `types.py`; each `tests/contracts/<id>.<Type>/` sample validates against its schema
Every M1 step and contract class imports with its contract signature, body `raise NotImplementedError("<its task id>")`; each component `__init__.py` exports its contract section
Replay doubles for `core.Env`, `core.Agent`, `evaluate.play` and `evaluate.compare` serve their fixtures

`seed_settings("L1", 3)` returns L1's settings with seed 3; `build` returns a `SnakeEnv` and `TableAgent` for L1 and L2 and a `CorridorEnv` for corridor settings; an unknown `kind` raises `ValueError`

On the `core.Env` and `core.Agent` replay doubles, `train` plays `games` games, calling `learn` after every step and `end_game` after every game; writes `settings.json`, `train_log.csv` and the agent; `load_log` reads the log back equal
`train_seeds` runs seeds 0–4 in turn and returns their settings; `report_runs` returns the last record per seed; `load_agents` reloads each seed's saved agent

On the `evaluate.play` and `evaluate.compare` doubles: 100 games per seed and 500 per bot are requested; `compare_bars` returns one "beats random" bar; `save_eval` writes `eval.json` that reads back as the same `Summary`
On the `train.GameRecord` and `evaluate.Summary` samples, `learning_curve` writes a PNG with the score smoothed over 100 games and one labelled line per bot, and returns a valid `plots.Figure`
The `replay.Replay` samples round-trip through `save` and `load` unchanged; a missing file raises `FileNotFoundError` and a damaged one `ValueError`
On the `core.Env` replay double, `rebuild` replays a recorded game's moves and reports a match; one changed move reports a mismatch
`view(sample, show=False)` draws the first frame with step, score and reward, and returns the replay unchanged
On the `evaluate.Summary` sample, `render_note` returns a `lab.Note` with the summary table and curve links; `write_note` writes it and refuses to overwrite
TC-08, TC-09 and TC-10 pass on the view functions given the `snake.SnakeState` inputs
TC-01–TC-07 pass through `SnakeEnv.from_state`
Given a new 10×10 game, the snake has 3 cells with the head in the centre and food off the body; the same seed and moves give identical games (GAME-09)
Reaching the right end gives +1 and `won`; 20 steps without winning gives `cut_off` with terminal false; the same seed and moves give identical frames
The default schedule gives 1.0 at game 0, 0.505 at game 500 and 0.01 from game 1,000 on, never rising; bad bounds raise `ValueError`
TC-11 passes
`n_situations` counts distinct observations seen; save then `load` gives the same values; the module imports nothing but NumPy and `rllab.core`
TC-15 passes
TC-16 passes on the four boards, read through an object exposing `state`

On the `core.Env` and `core.Agent` doubles: `explore=False` throughout, no `learn` calls, one score per game, ending counts summing to the game count, and the first `record` games returned as valid `replay.Replay`s
TC-18 and TC-20 pass; TC-21 fails its bar as expected
TC-19 passes on at most 3 of 20 seeds; `BarResult.test` names the procedure the skill chose
TC-17 passes; a rung's two bars are Holm-corrected together
The L1 and L2 summaries carry each rung's situation count; L2's has no bars
With `show=False` and simulated keys: ← → step and clamp at both ends; + − keep the speed within 1–20 steps per second
Agent replays show three labelled move values with the taken move marked; bot replays say "no values"
`python -m rllab train L1 --seed 0 --smoke` runs end to end; committed as PL-01's smoke test
TC-13 and TC-14 pass on the corridor; import-linter confirms the shared pieces import only `core`
PL-01's pre-build sections replaced by a `dt layout` pointer
`python -m rllab rung L1 --smoke` runs end to end and leaves five run folders with seeds 0–4; committed as PL-02's smoke test
PL-02's pre-build sections replaced by a `dt layout` pointer
`python -m rllab evaluate L1 --smoke` runs end to end, with bots on the rung's board size; committed as PL-03's smoke test
PL-03's pre-build sections replaced by a `dt layout` pointer
`python -m rllab watch <fixture replay> --smoke` runs end to end with the viewer hidden; committed as PL-04's smoke test
TC-22 passes; PL-04's pre-build sections replaced by a `dt layout` pointer
`python -m rllab note L2 --smoke` runs end to end; committed as PL-05's smoke test
TC-23 passes; PL-05's pre-build sections replaced by a `dt layout` pointer
